title: Appendix B - Dataset
consistency: Read-only MongoDB snapshot transaction across all nine selected collections.
scope: All records in the nine requested collections; no date or campus filter. Inventory scope is inherited through resource references; audit scope is inferred through related records where available.
originEvidence: User explicitly confirmed all records are test/demo records (synthetic). Every exported record includes dataOrigin=synthetic.
exportPurpose: Anonymized research appendix extract; not a complete database backup or restorable application dataset.
anonymization: Strict field allowlists; credentials, tokens, personal names, contact information, IDs, avatars, free-text notes, reasons, metadata, locations and verification text excluded. All ObjectIds replaced by consistent aliases. Resource names/categories aliased. Timestamps reduced to UTC dates. No reverse mapping saved.
